claim: From 8th October the UK government will combine weekly flu and covid reports.

sub_claims.question: Did the UK government announce a plan to combine weekly flu and COVID-19 surveillance reports in 2020?
sub_claims.answer: Yes, Public Health England (or related UK health authorities) did implement combined weekly reports for influenza and COVID-19 in October 2020 to improve respiratory illness surveillance during the pandemic.

evidence.statement: In October 2020, Public Health England initiated combined weekly surveillance reports for seasonal influenza and COVID-19 to streamline respiratory illness monitoring during the pandemic.

sub_claims.question: Was the start date for this combined reporting set to 8th October 2020?
sub_claims.answer: I am confident that combined reporting began in early October 2020, but I cannot confirm the exact date of 8th October; it is plausible that the first combined report was published around that time.

evidence.statement: Public Health England announced in late September 2020 that combined flu and COVID-19 reporting would begin in early October 2020.
The first joint report for influenza and COVID-19 by Public Health England was published in the week commencing 5 October 2020.
